snippet.title: Cozy Cleaner - Clean Cozy Room Corners - Gameplay Teaser (Steam)
snippet.description:
Cozy Cleaner is a relaxing cleaning game where you tidy and organize messy rooms. Pick up clutter, wipe away dirt, and bring order to every space for a calming, refreshing experience with cozy soundtracks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2742710/Cozy_Cleaner/
